sourceSelection: Original Trabalho C/headers/Makefile, initial userinfo.txt and service configuration. Unrelated labs, generated .depend and VCS ignore metadata omitted.

files.reason: Append the original CSV record without uninitialized concatenation storage or a ten-byte integer buffer; bound the existing thirty-byte username contract and path storage, and return on failed file opens.
files.verification: Original actual score-header append with patterned local storage and stack protector exits by signal. Corrected real-file prefix/append records ANA25 and BOB2147483647 match exactly, and a missing directory returns safely. Original CSV newline/name/comma/score layout is retained.

files.reason: Import the existing Sprite type owner so the original game declarations can be used by the project entry unit.
files.verification: Same original-entry regression fails before repair and passes with actual void game declarations and the complete Sprite-owned header.

files.reason: Import the actual Minix startup and game function owners, then call the original void start/menu/viewScore functions before returning success to the CLI.
files.verification: Original browser startup reports unreachable. Actual entry unit fails implicit-function declarations for sef_startup/start/menu/viewScore; corrected owning dispatch harness verifies all three original commands and successful zero status.

controlsRationale: Original Makefile selects GCC and contains implicit-int C90 globals; explicit build.cStandard gnu89 preserves the authored source. The original start <directory> <name> command launches gameplay directly, avoiding a text-only console menu on mobile. Source W/S make events move the penguin vertically, so authored repeatKeys provides held-button motion. Original relative vertical mouse input remains available; direct touch is not calibrated. Reserved panel keeps W/S, Pause and Escape away from original1024x768 indexed playfield.

artwork.icon: Original64x64 penguin XPM glyph from pixmap.h rendered as integer-scale SVG pixel rectangles using the preserved EGA DAC palette, on a dark square. No original asset changed.
artwork.preview: Actual browser up-steering game canvas, scaled640x480.

verification.browser: Normal touch844x390 and390x844 enters original indexed game through authored start command, moves W/S up/down, pauses/resumes with P, exits via Escape release with original score1 and normal status0. No page errors.
verification.ndk: All2 authored Makefile translation units, including their original included driver/game implementation units, compile as actual ARM64 objects with O2,FORTIFY2,stack protector and format-security.

native.demonstrated: Root inspected ordinary W/S vertical penguin movement, Pause with byte-identical whole playfield across delayed captures, Resume advancing gates, and original Escape exiting to Library without a crash. Shared pending-notification coalescing fixes the old timer backlog; no game input or pause rewrite.

verification.limits: Normal first-session game qualified; alternate spaceship selection/text-menu and long saved-history play unverified.
